description:
Traits with QTL or GWAS results, with counts per species (soybean (SoyBase QTL on genetic maps plus GWAS; marker positions on Wm82.a2 = Ensembl glycine_max), common bean (G19833 v1 = Ensembl phaseolus_vulgaris; some GWAS on G19833 v2), cowpea (IT97K-499-35 v1) and peanut (Tifrunner v2) from LIS; faba bean QTL markers from 56 studies (Faba Bean Genome Consortium compilation, positions on Hedin/2 v2 and projected to the Ensembl Hedin/2 v1 assembly); lentil protein and amino acid GWAS on the diversity panel (KnowPulse, CDC Redberry v2 = LIS lentil genes); chickpea, lentil, pea, faba bean, lupin, grass pea and pigeonpea QTL and GWAS from pulsedb.org (Cool Season Food Legume Database)).
query filters trait names (e.g. 'seed', 'rust').
name: legume_qtl_traits
